WITH revenue AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS order_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

          OR

      )
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date
),
yearly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN order_date >= '2025-11-20' AND order_date <= '2025-12-22' THEN 2025
            WHEN order_date >= '2024-11-20' AND order_date <= '2024-12-22' THEN 2024
        END AS year,
        SUM(order_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM revenue
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (
            (SELECT total_revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = 2025) -
            (SELECT total_revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = 2024)
        ) * 100.0 /
        (SELECT total_revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE year = 2024),
        1
    ) AS growth_percentage
FROM yearly_revenue
LIMIT 1;
